steps.name: Open Mattamy Homes home page for CAN in PROD
Page painted but rendered no header (attempt 1); reloading https://mattamyhomes.com/ca
Verify community search navigates to Yorkville

Required fields marked on the form First name, Last name, Email, Country of Residence, Zip/Postal Code, When do you want to move into your home?, Are you a first time homebuyer?, How many bedrooms do you need?, What is your budget?
Closed the AtlasRTX chat iframe before clicking
